title: Medical Administrator
location: Chester Le Street, DH2 1HS, Chester Le Street, DH2 2NH
description: Working as part of a Reception Team to ensure we deliver a high level of service to patients, doctors, nurses and other members of the practice team. To learn and develop in the skills required to be a exceptional Medical Administrator and Secretary. Always ensuring all policies and procedures are adhered. Greet and direct patients and visitors Make appointments using the Care Navigation Templates. Deal with Patient queries both face to face and over the telephone in a kind and professional manner Take requests for prescriptions Collect payments from patients for non NHS services Sort and date stamp all incoming patient related mail Scan, action and code patient related documents onto their medical records, ensuring any such documents are forwarded to the appropriate clinician for action Deal with a wide variety of Administrative tasks Making appointments and using the Care Navigation Templates to navigate the patient to the most appropriate care Taking requests for prescriptions Giving out results Ambulance transport bookings Home visit requests Deal with general enquiries and complaints both over the phone and face to face Various Medical Secretarial duties Collect payments from patients for non-NHS services Deal with a wide variety of complex Administrative duties Scan, action and code incoming mail and allocate to the most appropriate person for actioning

title: Admin Assistant
description: This Admin Assistant post sits within the administration team and is based at Birtley. The post holder will also support the team promoting Confidentiality, Collaborative Working, Service Delivery, Learning and Development and carry out other duties as directed by the management team. Interrogate and run regular searches of patient records to facilitate the planning of patient care Carry out patient contact & recall administration tasks for patients with long term conditions, Assist in seasonal campaigns such as flu or covid clinics including searches, invitations and data entry General administrative support to the Admin Team Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times Support all staff with general tasks as requested (appropriate to role) Listed below are the responsibilities this role will be primarily responsible for: Confidentiality is key to this job role. The surgery works within established protocols ensuring compliance with all mandatory regulations including (but not exhaustive); General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR), Data Protection Act, Caldicott Principles.
